note: Rewritten from the English description of the Prorhinotermes inopinatus entry in the revision of the New Guinea Rhinotermitidae, with sections for the alate and the soldier; the worker is not described in the original. The soldier measurement rows in the original are badly affected by OCR (for example ALL: 2.02201 65—22 16) AW 110 (113 = 1.53), and T3L: 35400 2— 1-48), so only the 4 legible items are recorded: head length, pronotal width, right mandible length and maximum postmentum width; left mandible length, pronotal length and hind tibia length are not recorded. The original glosses its measurement abbreviations in parentheses at their first occurrence.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head slightly rounded, with about 10 setae. Eye size variable. The major setae of the pronotum are distributed mainly along the margins. Measurements (mm; 12 alates from 2 colonies): total body length 4.38—6.72; head length 1.09—1.33; head width 1.20—1.47; pronotal length 0.65—0.81; pronotal width 1.09—1.27; forewing length 6.67—8.42; eye diameter 0.24—0.37.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head slightly elongate, with about 15 setae. Eyes medium-sized. Pronotum, mesonotum and metanotum long and wide. Each abdominal segment with 6—12 long setae. Mandibles large, slightly curved at the tip. Measurements (mm; holotype and 94 soldiers from 32 colonies, ranges in parentheses): head length 1.79 (1.39—1.85); pronotal width 1.17 (0.86—1.24); right mandible length 1.22 (0.95—1.40); maximum postmentum width 0.51 (0.37—0.57).
